question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
-- Final calculation: average number of new unicorn companies per year in Fintech from 2019-2021
-- Using date_joined as the "new" indicator

WITH distinct_companies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT company_id 
  FROM companies_dates
),
unicorn_companies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cf.company_id, cf.valuation, cd.date_joined, cd.year_founded, ci.industry
  FROM companies_funding cf
  JOIN distinct_companies dc ON cf.company_id = dc.company_id
  JOIN companies_dates cd ON cf.company_id = cd.company_id
  JOIN companies_industries ci ON cf.company_id = ci.company_id
  WHERE cf.valuation >= 1000000000
),
-- Top industry by total unicorn count
top_industry AS (
  SELECT industry
  FROM unicorn_companies
  GROUP BY industry
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- Count new unicorns per year in top industry
yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    uc.industry,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(uc.date_joined, 'T', 1) AS DATE)) as joined_year,
    COUNT(*) as num_unicorns
  FROM unicorn_companies uc
  JOIN top_industry ti ON uc.industry = ti.industry
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(uc.date_joined, 'T', 1) AS DATE)) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
  GROUP BY uc.industry, joined_year
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(num_unicorns), 2) as avg_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM yearly_counts
